body.content:
Sir,

The AMC Equipment Readiness Dashboard is ready for enterprise deployment. This Power BI solution provides real-time visibility into equipment status across all AMC commands.

Capabilities:
- Real-time equipment readiness rates by command, installation, and equipment type
- Maintenance backlog tracking and trend analysis
- Parts availability and supply chain status
- Predictive analytics for equipment failures
- Integration with GCSS-Army and depot management systems

Pilot Results (90-day test at Anniston Army Depot):
- Reduced time to identify readiness issues from days to minutes
- Improved decision-making for resource allocation
- 100% user adoption rate
- Positive feedback from all levels of leadership

Proposed Rollout:
- Phase 1 (Dec 2025): All Army depots
- Phase 2 (Feb 2026): Life Cycle Management Commands
- Phase 3 (Apr 2026): Enterprise-wide AMC deployment

Request: Approve dashboard for enterprise deployment and schedule demonstration for Senior Leader Forum.

Dashboard link: [Secure SharePoint site]

Respectfully,
Kevin Martinez
Chief Information Officer
AMC G-6
